documented_update_switch.name: check_for_update_on_startup
documented_update_switch.documented_meaning: Check for Codex updates on startup (set to false only when updates are centrally managed).
documented_update_switch.calibration: The official reference describes Codex update checks, not curated-plugin synchronization.

curated_plugin_sync_documentation_calibr: Direct, case-insensitive exact searches of the current official configuration-reference Markdown found no 'curated', 'curated-plugin', 'curated plugin', 'plugin sync', 'synchronization', destination URL, or multi_agent_v2 occurrence. The page documents general plugin MCP controls and check_for_update_on_startup, but does not name a setting governing curated-plugin synchronization. This is a documentation-absence finding only; exact 0.149.0 artifact behavior must be probed separately under N3.
